headline: Meninges mnemonic: your brain is PADded
stat_note: Pia, Arachnoid, Dura: from the brain out
body: Pia mater hugs the brain, arachnoid mater is the middle layer, and dura mater is the tough outer layer next to the skull. Cerebrospinal fluid cushions the brain between pia and arachnoid.

headline: The femur is your body's longest bone
stat_note: typical length of an adult femur
body: Your thigh bone is also the strongest and largest bone you have. It links the hip to the knee and carries your weight when you stand, walk and run.

headline: Skin is your body's largest organ
stat_note: skin weight of an average adult man
body: Spread out, it would cover about 16 to 21.5 square feet (1.5 to 2 square meters), measured for a 5 ft 11 in adult weighing about 154 lb.
source: Source: Guinness World Records, Largest human organ
